feature_notes.n_clean: log1p applied before fitting; stored as raw peak count in this manifest.
feature_notes.median_mz_gap: median adjacent m/z gap among top-50 peaks (Da)
feature_notes.top1_share_top50: share of the most intense peak
feature_notes.top5_share_top50: share of the five most intense peaks

preprocessing.duplicate_mz: sum intensity for exactly equal m/z
preprocessing.intensity_normalization: divide by total cleaned intensity before top-50, then sqrt
preprocessing.feature_input: raw DENS7 values with log1p(n_clean) only

training.negative_structures: not available for all negative spectra
training.notes: Ordinary negatives, not selected as structural analogues of PT.

cross_validation.note: The reported values come from the original 5-fold DENS7 RF run; the fresh OOF pass above reproduces the same pipeline.

error_profile_at_0.5.note: Threshold 0.5 on OOF probabilities; class breakdown not available for the prior negatives.

intended_use: Reference model showing the DENS7 signal on the original in-house negative sources.
Useful for comparing against the NIST and GNPS hard-negative checkpoints.
limitations: Negatives are ordinary in-house spectra, not structural analogues; performance is expected to be optimistic for hard-negative screening.
The original CV was stratified by spectrum, not grouped by structure for the negatives.
Do not use this checkpoint as the primary screening model.
data_redistribution: Training spectra are not included. NIST, GNPS and MoNA data remain subject to their own terms.
